# Shrink-only baseline: unclassified no-silent-fallback findings per file.
#
# Measured 2026-09-17 at 8020ec070: 169 unclassified across 59 files, from
# 587 high-risk lines. This replaces a baseline of 184/61 that was never
# correct -- it was generated by a mirror that failed to unescape \n in
# inventory fragments, so multi-line fragments matched nothing and 15
# findings across 5 files were counted unclassified when the gate classified
# them. Every number here comes from the gate's own semantics.
#
# LOWERED 2026-09-17 to 153 across 43 files (bd-apvhh burn-down tranche 1).
# Sixteen files left this list entirely: each had no inventory rule at all and
# exactly one finding, each was read in source, and each now carries a
# function-scoped rule that owns exactly that one site. A file is removed here
# only when its count reaches zero -- an entry at 0 would be indistinguishable
# from a file nobody has looked at yet.
#
# LOWERED AGAIN 2026-09-17 to 140 across 40 files (tranche 2). Three more files
# left entirely (contradiction_detect, global_store, mcp) and two shrank
# (decide 5->2, memory_debt 3->1). Verified against the PREVIOUS committed
# baseline before writing: five rows decreased, zero rows rose, no file gained a
# row. That check is the point -- regenerating this file from observation is
# only safe once you have proved the regeneration contains no increase.
#
# NOT GIVEN A ROW, DELIBERATELY: src/core/ask_corpus.rs. af22f1611 added two
# high-risk lines to it, and with no row here the ratchet read 2 against an
# allowance of 0 and had main red. The repair is the rule
# NSF-CORE-ASK-CORPUS-PER-RULE-MAPS, not an entry here. Adding a row would have
# recorded the new debt as accepted, which is exactly the move this ratchet
# exists to refuse -- a red caused by new debt is not a reason to widen the
# allowance.
#
# LOWERED AGAIN 2026-09-18 to 129 across 40 files (tranche 3): mesh/team.rs
# 10 -> 2 and core/resume.rs 7 -> 4, the two largest no-rule files, taken ahead
# of the easier remainder because they are where the answer could come back NOT
# allowed. It did: team.rs produced this burn-down's first must_fix (bd-1jpg7).
# Verified against the previous committed baseline: two rows decreased, zero
# rose, no file gained a row.
#
# THE ROWS THAT DID NOT GO TO ZERO ARE THE POINT. team.rs keeps 2 for bd-coxn1
# (origin_workspace_id on invite mint/redeem, where I could not finish the
# trace), and resume.rs keeps 4: one feeding admission.admit whose fail-open
# direction is unproved, and three `chosen`/`topic` sites that pose the same
# unresolved question as src/core/decide.rs. Leaving a count above zero is the
# honest output when the reading did not settle it; classifying them to reach
# zero would be the weakening.
#
# A count may only DECREASE. Raising one is new silent-fallback debt; lowering
# one after a fix is required (a stale entry decays into a permanent allowlist).
